rationale: The agent appears to have identified the user and retrieved order/product details, but then executed order-changing writes (modify_pending_order_items and modify_pending_order_address) without any visible customer confirmation, violating the stated policy. It also included a gift card payment_method_id in the modification even though the user did not request a payment change; later, the agent stated it was unable to change the payment method, which is inconsistent with its earlier write. There is no clear confirmation of the specific item variant changes (desk lamp black; backpack medium polyester, grey if available) before applying them. Due to missing confirmations and payment-method handling inconsistencies, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
